forkReviewCandidateUnavailable: This candidate comparison has a binary or unavailable file; inspect the individual changes below.
forkReviewCandidatesEqual: Both candidates have the same content for this file.
forkReviewConflict: This file conflicts with changes in the parent directory. Resolve the conflict before adopting it.
forkReviewParentChanged: The parent also changed this file. Adoption will preserve compatible parent changes.
forkReviewUnsupported: This file cannot be adopted automatically.
forkReviewApplied: Adopted {{count}} files into the parent directory.
forkReviewOtherCandidateOnly: Only the other candidate changed this file; there is no change to adopt from the selected candidate.
forkReviewDescription: Review changes since the saved fork baseline, then select files or hunks to adopt into the parent directory.
forkReviewNoBaseline: No saved fork baseline is available
forkReviewShared: These conversations share one directory. Changes are already shared and cannot be attributed to one conversation; adoption is unavailable.
forkReviewReloadRequired: Reload the comparison and review your selections before trying again.
forkReviewNoChanges: No changes to review. Older forks without a saved baseline cannot be compared.
forkReviewBinary: Binary file — select the whole file to adopt.
forkReviewWholeFile: This change is adopted as a whole file.
forkReviewPartialConflict: Whole-file adoption conflicts with parent changes. You may select individual hunks; the selected changes will be checked for conflicts again before adoption.
forkReviewPreviewTruncated: Preview limited to {{count}} lines. Adoption still uses the complete selected hunks or files.
forkChatDescription: Create an independent conversation with the current context. The original conversation stays available.
forkWorktree: Fork into a new Git worktree
forkWorktreeDescription: The worktree includes uncommitted changes and non-ignored new files. Requires a local Git repository with a commit.
forkWorktreeLocalOnly: Worktree forks are currently available for local projects.
